description: Search freelancers on Malt by keyword/skill and location, or enrich specific profile URLs. Supports all Malt markets: FR, DE, ES, BE, NL, COM.

location.description: Filter results by city or region, e.g. `Paris`, `Berlin`, `Barcelona`. Leave empty for all locations.
location.title: Location (city or region)

market.description: Which Malt regional marketplace to scrape.
market.title: Market (Malt domain)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of freelancer records to return.
maxItems.title: Max items

minRating.description: Only include freelancers with an average client rating at or above this value (0–5). Leave empty to include all.
minRating.title: Minimum average rating

minReviews.description: Only include freelancers with at least this many client reviews. Leave empty to include all.
minReviews.title: Minimum number of reviews

mode.description: Choose what to scrape: search for freelancers by keyword/location, or enrich specific profile URLs.
mode.title: Mode

profileUrls.description: List of Malt freelancer profile URLs to enrich, e.g. `https://www.malt.fr/profile/johndoe`. Used in mode=byProfileUrls.
profileUrls.title: Profile URLs (mode=byProfileUrls)

proxyConfiguration.description: Malt sits behind Cloudflare Bot Management, which blocks every Apify datacenter/AUTO IP outright (confirmed: 403 on 100% of requests, including via a headless browser). A European **Residential** proxy is required — datacenter proxies will not work. Residential proxy traffic is billed by Apify at $8/GB.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

searchQuery.description: Skill or keyword to search for, e.g. `python developer`, `react`, `data analyst`. Used in mode=searchFreelancers.
searchQuery.title: Search query (skill / keyword)

title: Malt Freelancers Scraper Input
